title: कस्तो हुँदैछ गौरी मल्लको तिहार ? न सेलको फन्को, न त दाजुभाइको रन्को
content:
काठमाडौँ । अत्यधिक सुनिने-हेरिने तिहार गीतककी सदाबहार नृत्य प्रस्तोता, अभिनेत्री गौरी मल्ललाई यसपालि तिहारको त्यति रौनक छैन । तर, सिङ्गो नेपाली समाज उनको सदाबहार प्रस्तुतिमा झुमिरहेकै छ, ‘तिहारै आयो, लौ झिलिमिली, सुन हजुर लक्ष्मी आइन् आँगन…।’ चलचित्र स्वर्गमा गौरीले शुभद्रा अधिकारी, विष्णु मल्लहरुसँग स्क्रीन शेयर गरेको उक्त गीतले पेश गर्ने तिहार भाइब्स लोभलाग्दो छ । नेपाल प्रेसले सोमबार विहान सम्पर्क गर्दा उनीचाहिँ दिक्क मानेर घरमै बसिरहेकी थिइन् । ‘पोहोर मुमाको मुमाको वर्षान्त थियो, यसपालि रसुवा बाढीको बिष्मातले पर्व मान्ने मुड छैन’, उनले सुनाइन् । यसपालि उनले सेल रोटी पनि पकाइनन् । सयपत्री माला त झन् टाढाको कुरा भयो । ‘केही गरौँ न त भनेर यसो सोच्यो, रसुवा बाढीमा बेपत्ता भएका मान्छे, तिनका परिवार, बालबच्चा सम्झिन्छु’, उनले भनिन्, ‘तिहारको शुभकामनाजस्तो नियमित औपचारिकता पनि निभाउन मन नलाग्ने भएको छ ।’ त्यसो त गौरीले जीवनमा पाउन नसकेको एउटा ‘सुख’ हो- दाजुभाइ नहुनु । तिहारमा कसैको निधारमा सप्तरङ्गको सर्को हाल्ने औपचारिकता त जीवनमा पूरा गरेकी छन् । तर, आज त्यो निधार भौतिक अस्तित्वमा छैन । चलचित्र सन्तानबाट रजतपटमा उदाएकी गौरीलाई उक्त चलचित्रमा अनुबन्ध गर्ने निर्देशक (गडफादर) प्रकाश थापालाई टीको लगाउने गरेकी थिइन् । २०६१ जेठ १३ गते उनको निधन भएयता २०४४ सालदेखिको तिहार निरन्तरतामा बिराम लाग्यो । गौरीलाई स्व. थापा छोरा विजयले फुपू भन्थे । उनलाई पनि गौरीले भाइ नै मानेर टीका लगाइदिने गरेकी थिइन् । अहिले विजयसित पनि नियमित भेटघाट छैन । विजय पनि चलचित्र निर्देशनमा संलग्न थिए । अहिले उनी रजतपट दुनियाँबाट ओझेल छन् । आइतबार लक्ष्मीपूजा थियोे । यसपालि पनि उनले पूजाआजा गरिनन् । कारण उही हो- पोहोर मुमाको वर्षान्त, यसपालि रसुवा बाढीको बिष्मात । उनी सेल रोटीकी त्यति शौखिन हैनन् । खानको शौखिन नभएपछि पकाउने तत्परता पनि नहुनु स्वाभाविक हुने भयो । तर, गौरी फूल र बत्तिको झिलिमिलीसँग रमाउने आदतकी छन् । यसपालि ती आदतले पनि उनलाई तानेन । ‘जताततै शोक र सन्ताप छ, देशको अवस्था ठीक छैन’, उनले भनिन्, ‘म एक्लैले कुन खुशीमा रमाउने ?’ नेपाल प्रेसले सोध्यो, ‘हामीलाई पढ्ने पाठकले गौरी मल्लको तिहार कस्तो हुँदैछ भनेर जिज्ञासा राख्दा के भन्ने ?’ उनको जवाफ छ, ‘देशलाई दु:ख छ, गौरी पनि दु:खी छे भन्दिनु ।’ तिहारजस्तै गौरीका नृत्य प्रस्तुतिले तीज पर्व पनि उत्तिकै उल्लासमय बनाउने गरेको छ । उनीद्वारा अभिनित चलचित्र कन्यादानमा प्रस्तुत ‘तीजको लहर आयो बरिलै…’ बोलको गीत पनि उत्तिकै सुनिनेमा पर्छ । रसुवा बाढीको बितण्डाले बिथोलिएको उनको मन तीन महिना बित्न लाग्दा पनि शान्त भएको छैन । तीज त रसुवा बाढीको पीडा आलो हुँदै आयो । त्यसैले यसपालि उनका लागि तीज पनि आएन । ‘कृत्रिम सुखको केही अर्थ हुँदैन, नक्कली खुशी देखाउन मन लाग्दैन’, उनले भनिन्, ‘अर्को साल देश र देशवासीलाई खुशी पार्ने गरी केही सोचौं, केही गरौँ, अनि चाडपर्व मनाऔंला ।’ Kathmandu. Actress Gauri Malla, the evergreen dance presenter of the much-heard and watched Tihar song, does not have much excitement for Tihar this year. However, the entire Nepali society is still dancing to her evergreen performance, 'Tihar is here, let it sparkle, listen, Lord Lakshmi has come to the courtyard...' The Tihar vibes presented by the song, in which Gauri shares the screen with Shubhadra Adhikari and Vishnu Malla in the movie Swargam, are enticing. When contacted by Nepal Press on Monday morning, she was sitting at home, feeling bored. "Last year was the end of the rainy season, this time I am not in the mood to celebrate the festival due to the floods in Rasuwa," she said. This time she did not even bake a loaf of bread. The hundred-leaf garland was even more distant. "I thought, 'Let's do something, I miss the people who went missing in the Rasuwa floods, their families, and children,'" she said. "I don't even feel like fulfilling the regular formalities like greetings on Tihar." So, one 'happiness' that Gauri has not been able to get in life is - not having a brother. She has completed the formality of putting a seven-color sarkora on someone's forehead during Tihar. However, today that forehead does not exist in physical existence. Gauri, who rose to fame from the movie Santhan, had asked Prakash Thapa, the director (godfather) who signed her for the movie, to put a sarkora on her forehead. Since his death on 2061 Jestha 13, the continuity of Tihar since 2044 BS has come to an end. Gauri was called aunt by late Thapa's son Vijay. Gauri also considered him as her brother and used to give him tika. Now there is no regular meeting with Vijay. Vijay was also involved in film directing. Now he is out of the silver screen world. Sunday was Lakshmi Puja. This time too, he did not perform the puja. The reason is the same - last year, it was the end of Muma's rainy season, this time, it was the end of the Rasuwa flood. She is not that fond of sela roti. Since she is not fond of eating, it is natural that she is not eager to cook. However, Gauri is used to enjoying the flowers and the twinkling of lights. This time, even that habit did not attract her. 'There is grief and sorrow everywhere, the situation in the country is not good,' she said, 'What happiness can I enjoy alone?' Nepal Press asked, 'What would you say when a reader asks you how Gauri Malla's Tihar is going?' His answer is, 'If the country is sad, Gauri is sad too.' Like Tihar, Gauri's dance performances have made Teej festival equally joyful. The song 'Teejko Lahar Ayo Barilai...' presented in the movie Kanyadan in which she acted is also worth listening to. Her mind, which was shattered by the devastation of the Rasuwa flood, has not calmed down even after three months. Teej came with the pain of the Rasuwa flood. That is why Teej did not come for her this year. "Artificial happiness has no meaning, I don't like to show fake happiness," she said. "Next year, let's think of something to make the country and its people happy, do something, and celebrate the festival."

आइतबार लक्ष्मीपूजा थियोे । यसपालि पनि उनले पूजाआजा गरिनन् । कारण उही हो- पोहोर मुमाको वर्षान्त, यसपालि रसुवा बाढीको बिष्मात ।

उनी सेल रोटीकी त्यति शौखिन हैनन् । खानको शौखिन नभएपछि पकाउने तत्परता पनि नहुनु स्वाभाविक हुने भयो । तर, गौरी फूल र बत्तिको झिलिमिलीसँग रमाउने आदतकी छन् । यसपालि ती आदतले पनि उनलाई तानेन । ‘जताततै शोक र सन्ताप छ, देशको अवस्था ठीक छैन’, उनले भनिन्, ‘म एक्लैले कुन खुशीमा रमाउने ?’

नेपाल प्रेसले सोध्यो, ‘हामीलाई पढ्ने पाठकले गौरी मल्लको तिहार कस्तो हुँदैछ भनेर जिज्ञासा राख्दा के भन्ने ?’ उनको जवाफ छ, ‘देशलाई दु:ख छ, गौरी पनि दु:खी छे भन्दिनु ।’

तिहारजस्तै गौरीका नृत्य प्रस्तुतिले तीज पर्व पनि उत्तिकै उल्लासमय बनाउने गरेको छ । उनीद्वारा अभिनित चलचित्र कन्यादानमा प्रस्तुत ‘तीजको लहर आयो बरिलै…’ बोलको गीत पनि उत्तिकै सुनिनेमा पर्छ । रसुवा बाढीको बितण्डाले बिथोलिएको उनको मन तीन महिना बित्न लाग्दा पनि शान्त भएको छैन । तीज त रसुवा बाढीको पीडा आलो हुँदै आयो । त्यसैले यसपालि उनका लागि तीज पनि आएन ।

‘कृत्रिम सुखको केही अर्थ हुँदैन, नक्कली खुशी देखाउन मन लाग्दैन’, उनले भनिन्, ‘अर्को साल देश र देशवासीलाई खुशी पार्ने गरी केही सोचौं, केही गरौँ, अनि चाडपर्व मनाऔंला ।’

Kathmandu. Actress Gauri Malla, the evergreen dance presenter of the much-heard and watched Tihar song, does not have much excitement for Tihar this year. However, the entire Nepali society is still dancing to her evergreen performance, 'Tihar is here, let it sparkle, listen, Lord Lakshmi has come to the courtyard...' The Tihar vibes presented by the song, in which Gauri shares the screen with Shubhadra Adhikari and Vishnu Malla in the movie Swargam, are enticing. When contacted by Nepal Press on Monday morning, she was sitting at home, feeling bored. "Last year was the end of the rainy season, this time I am not in the mood to celebrate the festival due to the floods in Rasuwa," she said. This time she did not even bake a loaf of bread. The hundred-leaf garland was even more distant. "I thought, 'Let's do something, I miss the people who went missing in the Rasuwa floods, their families, and children,'" she said. "I don't even feel like fulfilling the regular formalities like greetings on Tihar." So, one 'happiness' that Gauri has not been able to get in life is - not having a brother. She has completed the formality of putting a seven-color sarkora on someone's forehead during Tihar. However, today that forehead does not exist in physical existence. Gauri, who rose to fame from the movie Santhan, had asked Prakash Thapa, the director (godfather) who signed her for the movie, to put a sarkora on her forehead. Since his death on 2061 Jestha 13, the continuity of Tihar since 2044 BS has come to an end. Gauri was called aunt by late Thapa's son Vijay. Gauri also considered him as her brother and used to give him tika. Now there is no regular meeting with Vijay. Vijay was also involved in film directing. Now he is out of the silver screen world. Sunday was Lakshmi Puja. This time too, he did not perform the puja. The reason is the same - last year, it was the end of Muma's rainy season, this time, it was the end of the Rasuwa flood. She is not that fond of sela roti. Since she is not fond of eating, it is natural that she is not eager to cook. However, Gauri is used to enjoying the flowers and the twinkling of lights. This time, even that habit did not attract her. 'There is grief and sorrow everywhere, the situation in the country is not good,' she said, 'What happiness can I enjoy alone?' Nepal Press asked, 'What would you say when a reader asks you how Gauri Malla's Tihar is going?' His answer is, 'If the country is sad, Gauri is sad too.' Like Tihar, Gauri's dance performances have made Teej festival equally joyful. The song 'Teejko Lahar Ayo Barilai...' presented in the movie Kanyadan in which she acted is also worth listening to. Her mind, which was shattered by the devastation of the Rasuwa flood, has not calmed down even after three months. Teej came with the pain of the Rasuwa flood. That is why Teej did not come for her this year. "Artificial happiness has no meaning, I don't like to show fake happiness," she said. "Next year, let's think of something to make the country and its people happy, do something, and celebrate the festival."
